RESUME-RECOVERY CLAUSE (owner decision 22 of 2026-09-18, copied unchanged from cell PLAN's failure policy): an infrastructure death with code and request bytes unchanged may be recovered as a resume-recovery under item E10, keeping every complete row without selection under invariant I7r, re-flying every partial or unstarted row under the same run id, changing no question, roster, comparator, decision rule or cap, and re-checking the run-cumulative budget. A partial manifest is never scored and never read.
